releaseNotes:
Official Release v1.3.30:
- Direct ESC/POS Thermal Printing & Bill Check: Direct raw high-speed thermal printing pipeline for customer receipts and guest bill checks via Windows Spooler (`print_raw.ps1`), eliminating silent print failures and integrating auto paper cuts.
- Kitchen Display (KDS) Direct Order Bumping: Bump orders instantly with mouse click or numeric keypad without requiring employee card scans or modal pop-ups. Database updated to match orders by UUID, ticketNumber, or ticketDisplay.
- Smart Keypad Controls & Bilingual Cheatsheet Bar: Fast KDS navigation with persistent cheatsheet bar [1-9/0: Select/Tabs] [DEL/.: Bump Order] [TAB: Next Page/Hist] [ENTER: View Ticket] [+/-: Move Next/Prev] [0 0: Shut Down] with multi-digit number buffering.
- Kiosk Button Cleanup: Removed obsolete 'Install Kiosk on this PC' banners from KDS and station screens.
- Hardware & Software Sentinel Clean Scroll: Eliminated nested double scrollbars in Cashier tab for a clean single-view diagnostic monitor.
- 100% Quality Bottle Standard: Certified with 36 automated pre-flight vector tests passing at 100.0% zero defects.
